def: a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete

occurrences.text: Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God.
One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
